usage: The word '下年' is a noun referring to the year following the current year.
'下年' can be used as a time expression in sentences to indicate when something will happen.
In casual conversation, '下年' is commonly used to talk about plans or events in the next calendar year.
'下年' can appear in both positive and negative sentences when discussing future events.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 haa6 nin4 soeng2 heoi3 leoi5 haang4
examples.meaning: I want to travel next year.

examples.jyutping: haa6 nin4 ngo5 wui5 faan1 hok6
examples.meaning: Next year, I will go back to school.
He/She is getting married next year.

examples.jyutping: haa6 nin4 m4 hou2 gam3 mong4 laa1
examples.meaning: Don't be so busy next year.
